briefdescription.para: This builds on the llvm/ADT/GraphTraits.h file to find the strongly connected components (SCCs) of a graph in O(N+E) time using Tarjan's DFS algorithm.

detaileddescription.para: The SCC iterator has the important property that if a node in SCC S1 has an edge to a node in SCC S2, then it visits S1 after S2.
To visit S1 before S2, use the scc_iterator on the Inverse graph. (NOTE: This requires some simple wrappers and is not supported yet.)
